sections.changelog:
Fixed

  • **Category counts follow the synonyms of a half-typed word.** The result list expands the trailing word by prefix, so a rule fires while the word is still being written ("чех" already reaches чехол / бампер / кейс) — but the counts under the dropdown categories were built without that expansion. The badge therefore promised far less than a click delivered, and most often showed nothing at all: the unfinished word matches no term of its own, so the category group came back empty while the list underneath held dozens of products. Measured over real queries cut mid-word on a 15k-object catalogue: the prefix rule fires on 70% of them, and the category group went from silent on 27 of 40 inputs to silent on 18 — the rest now carry a number, and every number matches what its click opens. The 18 that remain come from the typo pass, which the counts still do not run.
